put.summary: Update an existing form of a business unit
put.description: Updates the form with the given ID and provided data (label name and visibility). The form must belong to the authenticated user's business unit.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the form to be updated

business_unit_id.description: The ID of the business unit

label_name.description: The label name of the form

is_hidden.description: Whether the form is hidden or not

message.example: Business unit ID not found in session.
Unauthorized: Cannot update form from different business unit.

put.summary: Hide a form of a business unit
put.description: Hide a specific form by its ID by setting is_hidden to true.

parameters.name: form
parameters.description: The ID of the form to be hidden.

put.summary: Unhide a form of a business unit
put.description: Unhide a specific form by its ID by setting is_hidden to false.

parameters.name: form
parameters.description: The ID of the form to be unhidden.

post.summary: Create form details of a form in a business unit

field_type.description: Type of the field (e.g., text, number, etc.)

is_required.description: Indicates if the field is required

put.description: Updates a specific form detail entry with new values.

form_id.description: The ID of the business unit

field_name.description: The label name of the form

field_type.description: Whether the form is hidden or not

is_required.description: The ID of the business unit

field_value.description: The label name of the form
